title: Google Chrome releases stable channel update for desktop
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-302.040320: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY- GOOGLE CHROME RELEASES STABLE CHANNEL UPDATE FOR DESKTOP
leadParagraph: The stable channel has been updated to 80.0.3987.162 for Windows, Mac, and Linux, which will roll out over the coming days/weeks.
contentHtml:
The stable channel has been updated to 80.0.3987.162 for Windows, Mac, and Linux, which will roll out over the coming days/weeks.

A list of all changes is available in the log which can be viewed here: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+log/80.0.3987.149..80.0.3987.162?pretty=fuller&n=10000.

If you are interested in switching release channels or find a new issue and need to file the bug you can refer to the following links respectively:  

  • https://www.chromium.org/getting-involved/dev-channel.
  • https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/list

There is also a community forum whereby one can reach out for help and learn about common issues.

The link for this community help forum is as follows:

https://support.google.com/chrome/community/?hl=en&gpf=%23!forum%2Fchrome

The Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) encourages users and administrators to review and apply the necessary updates.

Kindly review the following link for further reference:

https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2020/03/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_31.html
